龙国篇第一章异能兽的入侵
“什么？米娜塔斯城有异能兽入侵？”
丽莎顿时花容失色，她看着眼前的秘书“艾米”
，也不知该说些什么，于是，一言不发地快步走向作战室。
一路上，她紧紧咬着下唇，喃喃自语道：“立刻把米娜塔斯城的详细情况发给我，我需要马上召集武神！”
阳光透过她如丝般柔顺的秀发，将那一头金灿灿的长发照耀得格外亮丽动人。
再配上那精美的发簪和近乎完美的身材，更是让人眼前一亮。
即使在如此焦急的时刻，她生气的模样依然毫不逊色于其他女子。
原本今天她身着一袭华美的裙子，正准备去享受购物的乐趣，但突如其来的异能兽入侵事件却打破了她的计划。
毕竟，她可是“武神国”
的武主啊！
武神国肩负着守护世间万物、抵御邪恶势力的神圣使命，对于任何威胁到世界和平的恶势力都绝不姑息。
当丽莎轻轻推开办公室大门的时候，她的呼吸瞬间变得急促起来，仿佛整个空间都弥漫着一种紧张而压抑的气氛。
她敏锐地察觉到，今天的一切都显得格外不同寻常。
在书架旁，一个少年静静地倚靠着墙壁，他的身影在微弱的光线下若隐若现。
那乌黑亮丽的帅气三七分也无法掩盖住他紧皱的眉头和沉思的神情。
他沉默不语，似乎沉浸在自己的思绪之中，仿佛外界的喧嚣与他毫无关系，他站在黄昏的余晖中，外貌如同精心雕琢的艺术品，散发着独特而迷人的魅力。
他身材不算高大，但很挺拔，仿佛一棵矗立在风中的小松树，给人以坚实而可靠的感觉。
他的眉宇间透出一股坚毅与果敢，犹如刀刃般锐利，仿佛能够穿透人心。
他的眼睛是深邃的赤黄色，宛如太阳下的希望，清澈而深邃，透露出一种沉静而睿智的气质。

每当他凝视远方，那双眼睛就仿佛能够穿越时空，洞察一切。
他的鼻梁高挺，线条流畅，赋予了他一种独特帅气。
皮肤在阳光下呈现出健康的米白色，散发着青春与活力的气息，他衣着总是简约而不失品味，一件深色的衬衫，一条笔挺的西裤，再加上一双精致的战斗靴，无不透露出他的品味与格调，举手投足间都散发着一种从容不迫的气质，仿佛无论面对何种困境，都能够游刃有余地应对。
他的外貌不仅仅是外在的装饰，更是他内在气质的体现，每一个细节都散发着独特的魅力，让人无法忽视他的存在。
然而，当少年的目光与丽莎相遇的瞬间，他的身体像是被一股无形的力量驱动着，毫不犹豫地伸出双手，紧紧抓住了丽莎的手臂。
丽莎微微一笑，试图用轻松的语气打破这片沉默：“阿恒，怎么啦？是不是遇到什么烦心事了？阿姐可忙得很呢，如果没什么重要的事情，不如去看看书放松一下吧！”
叶恒的眼神坚定而执着，他凝视着丽莎那双犹如水晶般清澈透明的眼睛，声音低沉但充满决心地说道：“阿姐，我不想再袖手旁观了。
我渴望加入战斗，与大家并肩作战，共同对抗那些可怕的异能兽！”
丽莎的脸上闪过一丝惊愕，随后又迅速转化为关切和担忧。
她轻轻拍了拍叶恒的手背，轻声安慰道：“阿恒，战场可不是闹着玩的地方。
你现在才17岁又刚踏入B级初期武神，要面对那些强大的异能兽谈何容易？这太危险了，我不能让你冒险。”
叶恒眼神坚定地看着丽莎姐说道：“B级武神又不是不能去战斗，请相信我丽莎姐，我可是要成为未来最强武神！”
眼看着丽莎实在无法改变叶恒的决定，最终只能无奈地点头表示同意。
她语气严肃地嘱咐道：“好吧，但你千万不要过于逞强，一定要懂得灵活应对各种情况。
尤其是不能轻易使用武神之力暴走这项禁术，除非到了生死攸关、迫不得已的时候才可以动用它！”
叶恒毫不犹豫地回答道：“是是是，我亲爱的丽莎姐，您就放心吧！”
然而，丽莎的话音未落，叶恒已经迫不及待地离开了作战指挥室，并低声喃喃自语道：“这孩子真是让人头疼啊，真担心他会因为情绪失控而施展武神之力暴走……”
content_en:
Dragon Kingdom Chapter 1: Invasion of Supernatural Beasts
"What? There is an invasion of supernatural beasts in Minatas City?"
Lisa's beauty suddenly turned pale. She looked at the secretary "Amy" in front of her.
, didn’t know what to say, so he walked quickly to the war room without saying a word.
Along the way, she bit her lower lip tightly and murmured to herself: "Send me the details of Minatas City immediately. I need to summon the Martial Gods immediately!"
The sun shines through her silky hair, making her long golden hair particularly bright and beautiful.
Coupled with the exquisite hairpin and almost perfect figure, it is even more eye-catching.
Even in such an anxious moment, she still looked as angry as any other woman.
Originally, she was wearing a gorgeous dress today and was about to enjoy shopping, but the sudden invasion of supernatural beasts broke her plan.
After all, she is the "Martial God Country"
Martial Lord!
The Kingdom of Martial God shoulders the sacred mission of protecting all things in the world and resisting evil forces. It will never tolerate any evil forces that threaten world peace.
When Lisa gently pushed open the office door, her breathing became rapid in an instant, as if the entire space was filled with a tense and depressing atmosphere.
She was keenly aware that everything today seemed extraordinarily unusual.
Next to the bookshelf, a young man leaned quietly against the wall, his figure vaguely visible in the dim light.
His dark and handsome appearance couldn't hide his frown and thoughtful expression.
He was silent, seemingly immersed in his own thoughts, as if the hustle and bustle of the outside world had nothing to do with him. He stood in the afterglow of dusk, his appearance was like a carefully carved work of art, exuding a unique and charming charm.
He is not tall, but very tall, like a small pine tree standing in the wind, giving people a solid and reliable feeling.
There was perseverance and determination between his brows, as sharp as a blade, as if it could penetrate people's hearts.
His eyes were a deep red-yellow color, like hope under the sun, clear and deep, revealing a calm and wise temperament.
Whenever he stared into the distance, his eyes seemed to be able to travel through time and space and see everything.
The bridge of his nose is high and the lines are smooth, giving him a unique handsomeness.
His skin shows a healthy off-white color in the sun, exuding youth and vitality. His clothes are always simple yet tasteful. A dark shirt, a pair of crisp trousers, and a pair of exquisite combat boots all reveal his taste and style. His every move exudes a calm and unhurried temperament, as if he can deal with any difficulties he faces with ease.
His appearance is not only an external decoration, but also a reflection of his inner temperament. Every detail exudes unique charm, making it impossible to ignore his existence.
However, the moment the boy's eyes met Lisa's, his body seemed to be driven by an invisible force. He stretched out his hands without hesitation and grabbed Lisa's arm tightly.
Lisa smiled slightly and tried to break the silence with a relaxed tone: "Ah Heng, what's the matter? Are you encountering something troublesome? Sister is very busy. If there is nothing important, why not go read a book and relax!"
Ye Heng's eyes were firm and persistent. He stared at Lisa's crystal-clear eyes, and said in a low but determined voice: "Sister, I don't want to stand idly by anymore.
I am eager to join the battle and fight side by side with everyone to fight against those terrible supernatural beasts! "
A flash of surprise flashed across Lisa's face, which quickly turned into concern and worry.
She patted the back of Ye Heng's hand gently and comforted softly: "A Heng, the battlefield is not a place for fun.
You are only 17 years old now and have just entered the early stage of B-level martial arts. You have to face those powerfulHow easy is it to create a supernatural beast? This is too dangerous and I can't let you risk it. "
Ye Heng looked at Sister Lisa with firm eyes and said: "It's not like B-level Martial Gods can't fight. Please believe me, Sister Lisa, I want to become the strongest Martial God in the future! "
Seeing that Lisa couldn't change Ye Heng's decision, she could only nod helplessly in agreement.
She warned in a serious tone: "Okay, but you must not be too pushy, and you must know how to deal with various situations flexibly.
In particular, you cannot easily use the power of the God of War to run away, a forbidden technique. You can only use it when it is a matter of life and death and you have no choice but to use it! "
Ye Heng replied without hesitation: "Yes, yes, my dear Sister Lisa, don't worry! "
However, before Lisa finished speaking, Ye Heng could not wait to leave the combat command room, and murmured to himself in a low voice: "This child is really a headache. I'm really worried that he will use the power of the God of War to run away because he loses control of his emotions..."
